text: ana: Quick heads-up: my PR #4702 (SDK streaming examples + migration note) just failed the docs CI preview. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/4702 docs-ci-bot: Preview ready: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/4702 — results: linkcheck ERROR, vale WARNINGS, markdownlint OK lee: Can you paste the failing linkcheck output? ana: (typo, meant ana) LinkCheck output: ``` LinkCheckError: 1 broken link found: - /docs/guides/migrate-v2#streaming -> 404 Not Found ``` priya: That anchor moved when we renamed the migration guide section to `Streaming API`. The correct anchor is `#streaming-api`. The SDK example references `#streaming`. ana: Thanks — I missed that. Vale flagged a couple of nits too: ``` docs/guides/sdk-streaming.md:27: warning: Avoid using 'just' docs/guides/sdk-streaming.md:81: warning: Passive voice detected ``` ben: For the anchor quickfix I ran: ``` sed -i "s/#streaming/#streaming-api/g" docs/guides/sdk-streaming.md ``` That fixed linkcheck locally. For the wording, try: ```diff - This will just stream partial tokens as they arrive. + This streams partial tokens as they arrive in real time. ``` priya: LGTM. Another option is adding an alias anchor in the migration guide (``) but I prefer updating the reference to match the canonical header. release-manager: Is this safe to merge before the 17:00 release cutoff? It's docs-only and the migration guide is referenced by the release notes. I'd prefer to merge now and delay pushing release notes until after the cut if CI is green. ana: It's docs-only, no code. If CI goes green I'm fine merging now. Can folks :eyes:? lee: :eyes: looks fine to me. ben: :shipit: from my side. priya: +1. docs-ci-bot: New preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/4702 — all checks PASSED :white_check_mark: release-manager: OK merge and hold release-notes update until after cut. ana: Merging in 60s unless anyone objects. Thanks for the quick reviews!
